subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He has grown __into a beautiful youth__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"beautiful"** means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. (सुंदर)

 
 
• **Example: **She wore a** beautiful** dress to the party.
 
 
 
• **"Handsome"** refers to a good-looking, attractive, and well-proportioned appearance, typically used for males. (सुंदर)
 
 
• **Example: **He was a **handsome** young man with a charming smile.
 
 

Hence,** "handsome" **is more appropriate when referring to a male youth, as it is commonly used to describe male attractiveness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** *"in a handsome youth"* (एक सुंदर युवक में): Incorrect preposition usage.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He has grown in a handsome youth.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** *"a beautiful youth"* (एक सुंदर युवक): Does not require substitution but is less commonly used for males.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He has grown a beautiful youth.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** *"in a beautiful youth"* (एक सुंदर युवक में): Incorrect preposition usage.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He has grown in a beautiful youth.
 
 

40:Tc96,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
